title: Log Splitter Cover in Black 210D – Keeps Moisture and Dirt Away
seo_title: Log Splitter Cover in Black 210D – Protection Between Jobs
seo_description: Log splitter cover in black 210D fabric with a drawstring in the hem. Goes over the whole log splitter on legs and keeps moisture and dirt away between jobs.
descriptionHtml:
The moisture already settling on the log splitter

The log splitter stands outside on its legs between each session, and moisture and dirt settle on the metal long before you've even thought of covering it. The next time you're about to split a batch of firewood you're met by the same coating on the handle and legs.

A black 210D cover that fully covers the log splitter

The cover in black 210D fabric goes over the whole log splitter, legs and all, and is tightened with the drawstring in the hem so it stays on between sessions.

Features

  • Moisture and dirt are kept off the metal – the 210D fabric cover fully covers the log splitter.
  • Stays on between each session – the drawstring in the hem is tightened around the bottom edge of the cover.
  • Discreet black color – the cover is sewn from black 210D fabric.
  • Covers the legs too – the cover goes over the whole log splitter, legs and all.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

The log splitter is not included, only the cover.

Our guarantee

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
